historicalToolProfile.role: Compatibility data only. Exact fresh toolchain/copies/argv/versions/hashes must be rebound; no old candidate semantic inheritance.

requiredTools.name: typescript
requiredTools.load: Exact lib/tsc.js and complete library map

requiredTools.name: undiciTypes
requiredTools.load: Exact declared tree, not ambient node_modules

requiredTools.name: git
requiredTools.load: Explicit executable and read-only selected-object argv; no shell or mutable HEAD lookup

environment.allPaths: Canonical regular owned/materialized roots; no symlinks/hardlinks or host fallback

loader.runtimeEntry: Explicit authenticated compiled .js/.mjs entry in each source-built or installed-moved package; no source TS loader.
loader.declarationEntry: Actual declaration map and inspected exports; fixture token substitution only, no tsconfig paths.
loader.resolution: Allow only declared builtins and relative compiled modules inside the authorized root with authenticated parent URL and bytes. Unknown package, URL query/fragment, data/http/file escape, workspace or ambient node_modules resolution fails before load.
loader.loadedProof: Actual load records with canonical paths/hash/parent plus invoked namespace/command; guard denial is not a loaded-code control.
loader.capability: In-process non-forgeable admission/materialization binding; never deserialize old WeakSet/WeakMap capabilities.
loader.javascriptLimit: Trusted host JavaScript is not an OS sandbox. Import denial is not opaque host preemption or a proof against arbitrary escaped descendants.

recipeRoots: future consumer recipe and authenticated fixture root
guards.beforeAfter: Exact recursive membership including added files and empty directories; bytes/SHA256/modes and physical root identity; no hidden broad exclusions.
guards.selectedOriginAuthority: Exact fixed baseline + accepted interpreter + independently authorized new source blobs. Do not validate broad candidate HEAD or accept a fake composite commit.
guards.package: Full baseline package with byte/mode-exact baseline README and all expected compiler files/maps; not a yq-only projection.
guards.moves: Fresh regular copies followed by physical move; retain and recheck every prior moved tree, its dev/inode, staging absence and parent membership before next admission.
guards.rootReceipt: Expected raw hash supplied independently, bound exact path, no duplicate/unknown/missing fields. Bind every candidate/tool/recipe/build receipt before load.
guards.evidence: Unique no-clobber atomic publication outside candidate/recipe roots; raw stdout/stderr bytes, code/signal/rejection/effects/events and phase timestamps before assertions. Never overwrite old captures.

resourceBounds.storageRationale: 179*64MiB package-copy allowance +335*16MiB raw worker captures +12*8MiB compiler captures + bounded base/source/tool trees fit24GiB. Admission checks reservations; ceilings, not observed usage.

failureRules.safeContinuation: Only ordinary bound assertion failures or UNRUN obligations, including a semantic timeout after successful admission, may continue with integrity AND known reap positively proved and unchanged absolute deadlines. Timeout/nonzero remains sticky aggregate FAIL. Any source/runtime admission failure or admission timeout stops.
failureRules.nonzero: Every actual worker/parent nonzero/signal/timeout is aggregate FAIL even PASS receipts. Expected compiler diagnostic rejection is internal to a zero-exit type worker only.
failureRules.coverage: Phase absent/deadline/remaining-budget refusal => UNRUN with cause, never automatic product bug.
failureRules.malformed: Missing/duplicate/malformed job receipt or phase event cannot green a stage; uncertain admission/integrity stops.

optimization.default: Fresh process per semantic/control invocation, repeated authority verification/copy and full cumulative moved-tree guards retained.
optimization.futureOnly: Any such optimization needs its own exact code delta/seal, security argument and cache/transplant/mutation/added-entry negative controls; no optimization is assumed by this schedule.

toolInvocationTemplates.purpose: Independent scoped compile and declaration fixtures only

toolInvocationBinding: Templates are not runnable authorization. Exact tool hashes, argv/flags, immutable selected objects, configuration bytes and owner/PID bridge must be sealed before fresh GO. Tool metadata cannot confer source authority or read unrelated host files.
